senses.definition: A short list of things likely to go wrong, given in advance so nobody is surprised.
distractors: The one thing that must go right for the plan to work at all.
A list of everything already agreed, kept so that nobody reopens it.
Problems discovered only after a release has gone out to customers.
A written summary of what a meeting decided, circulated afterwards to everyone who missed it.
The set of conditions that must hold true for an estimate to be worth anything at all.
